{{Top|leg}}
'''Dens''' were groups of [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]]. The den was centered around a fertile "[[Den mother|queen]]," and included several fertile males and a larger number of sterile females. The dens were further organizes into several [[sept]]s. Offspring sired by the same fertile male belonged to the same sept.<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
